description: This file contains utility functions for managing chat session filters in an Android app, including generating user-friendly session names and resolving session choices based on recent activity and current session selection.

classes.name: ChatSessionEntry
classes.description: Represents a chat session entry with properties such as key and last updated timestamp.

methods.name: friendlySessionName
methods.description: Generates a human-readable name from a raw session key by stripping prefixes, removing gateway indicators, splitting words, and title-casing them.

methods.name: resolveSessionChoices
methods.description: Determines a list of relevant chat session entries based on the current session, recent activity within a time window, and main session key, ensuring the current session is included if not already present.
